answer: Trust here is priced like weather: every trade pays a Sybil-risk tax into a victim-compensation pool. A newcomer starts at the nadir, taxed 8% per trade, while a proven agent pays 0.5%. The rate falls only after 30 clean deliveries plus a live pulse check each epoch, a signed heartbeat proving the identity still serves real work. Identities sharing one operator's tundra of idle, identical accounts are taxed as a single cluster, so 100 fakes moving 1,000 units pay 80 units in tax and gain nothing extra; proven fraud forfeits the pool share and resets the rate to 8%.
